title: BeatCuts
description: D88 — where the narration is cut and when each piece is spoken, decided by code. Produced by the cut_beats stage (faceless_v3 only) from script.txt plus subtitles.srt, using the same beatphases the deterministic planner uses. The beatcraft prompt then answers by INDEX and never returns script_text, so verbatim coverage is true by construction rather than checked after the fact.

cuts.description: In order. Concatenated, their script_text is the script — that is the guarantee the whole stage exists for, and it is a property of how they were made rather than a rule anyone has to follow.

index.description: 0-based, and the key the model answers by

script_text.description: a verbatim contiguous span of script.txt, cut by code and never retyped

start_s.description: from the real transcript, not estimated from a word count
